title: Wholesome Changes
description: Opinionated Edits to the Vanilla Game!
body:
# ABOUT THE RESOURCE PACK
Looking for a random texture pack to shake things up a little? Do you like finding random bits, chips, and easter eggs in games?! Are you going to spend **22** _MILLION HOURS_ wasting away at a random task that you shouldn't be doing?!?!?!?

Well then, **Wholesome Changes** is here to provide a very random experience to _YOUR_ Vanilla Experience! I'm here to offer "opinionated" edits to Vanilla's textures, texts, and sounds! The changes are mostly wholesome, some a little jarring, and others might even be a bit too... angst? SO WHAT ARE YOU WAITING FOR?! ~~_Afterall, there's no harm in trying something new_~~.

## DISCLAIMER (PLEASE READ)
_This is project is a **WORK IN PROGRESS**, and not everything shown is final. The changes made are also mostly random, and just things I think looks cool, but I am open to taking suggestions. If you want to see something added, edited, or changed, just contact me on Discord (@icehero22yt) and let's discuss it! Also please contact me if there are any issues regarding the pack._

_This is my first time putting A LOT of effort into a texture pack (especially one that is being published), so not everything is gonna look good. Any assistance that you want to provide would be greatly appreciated! :3_
